other_conditions: Student must be a permanent resident of Assam.
Student must have taken an education loan from a commercial or rural bank recognised by the Reserve Bank of India.
Parents must have an education loan of more than Rs 1 lakh.
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time subsidy of up to Rs 50,000 on education loans up to Rs 1 lakh, with the student contributing 25% of the loan amount.
